hookbank.name: Gifting: 'I'm freezing' / 'Take this'
hookbank.line: Oh my God, I'm freezing

hookbank.name: Store: customer with the cart
hookbank.line: Found it at the store and I'm not leaving without it

hookbank.name: Store: ribbon launch
hookbank.line: Grand opening. 3… 2… 1…

hookbank.name: Store: staff reveal the aisle
hookbank.line: Restock day. Blink and it's gone.

hookbank.name: Drop-open overhead (viral format)
hookbank.line: Do NOT let a Christmas mom see this… 😳🎄

hookbank.name: Packaged robe pushed at the lens (146M format)
hookbank.line: I made this for the cold-aholics.. 😭🎄

hookbank.name: Wraps up, sinks into the sofa
hookbank.line: Every Christmas grump NEEDS this 🎄

hookbank.name: Ice on the INSIDE of the window
hookbank.line: when there's ice on the INSIDE of your window
hookbank.scene: The person stands at the bedroom window scraping a thick layer of white frost off the INSIDE of the glass with a plastic card, frost flakes falling on the sill, snowy morning outside, shoulders hunched with cold, looking back over the shoulder at the camera in disbelief.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: Hair dryer down the top
hookbank.line: stop doing this to stay warm (there's a better way)
hookbank.scene: The person sits on the edge of the bed holding a running hair dryer, the collar of their top pulled open with the other hand, pointing the hot air down inside their top, eyes closed in pure relief, a few strands of hair blown up by the air.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: Cold feet on the partner
hookbank.line: my partner when I put my feet on him at night
hookbank.scene: Night, bedroom lit by a warm bedside lamp. The person lies in bed under a duvet with a mischievous grin, next to their adult partner who is asleep on their side facing away; the person holds the edge of the duvet, about to slide closer under the covers.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: Space heater warms one side
hookbank.line: the space heater only warms the side facing it
hookbank.scene: The person sits cross-legged on the floor directly in front of a small portable space heater glowing orange; the front of their body is bathed in warm glow while they twist around to warm their back, rubbing their arms, frustrated.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: Thermostat war (64°)
hookbank.line: he said 64 is "plenty warm"
hookbank.scene: The person reaches toward a plain white wall thermostat whose simple display shows 64, fingertip an inch from the button, while another adult's hand enters from the edge of the frame and covers the thermostat; the person turns their head to the camera with a betrayed, deadpan look.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: Finally warm, remote is over there
hookbank.line: when you're finally warm but the remote is over there
hookbank.scene: The person lies on the sofa wrapped tightly in a plain grey fleece blanket like a burrito, only the face visible, staring with dread at a TV remote lying on the coffee table just out of reach.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: Bed-to-coffee walk in January
hookbank.line: the walk from my bed to the coffee maker in January
hookbank.scene: Early morning in the kitchen with a cold tile floor: the person tiptoes barefoot across the tiles toward the coffee maker, one foot lifted, hugging themselves tightly, face scrunched from the cold, soft blue dawn light from the window.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: I can see my breath INSIDE
hookbank.line: I can see my breath. INSIDE.
hookbank.scene: The person stands in the middle of their living room hugging themselves and exhaling, a clearly visible cloud of breath hanging in the air in front of their face indoors, a wall thermostat visible behind them, eyes wide in disbelief.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: Cat on the heating vent
hookbank.line: the cat found the only warm spot in the house
hookbank.scene: A cat lies sprawled blissfully on a floor heating vent, eyes closed; the person kneels right next to it, both hands hovering over the tiny free corner of the vent, glaring at the cat with jealousy.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: December gas bill
hookbank.line: my December gas bill made me do something drastic
hookbank.scene: The person stands at the kitchen counter holding an opened utility envelope and a printed letter (no readable text), jaw dropped, the other hand pressed to their forehead in shock, the kitchen bright and ordinary around them.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: Cold sheets should be illegal
hookbank.line: getting into cold sheets should be illegal
hookbank.scene: The person has just slid into bed under the covers: body rigid as a plank, arms clamped to their sides, eyes wide open, teeth clenched, the duvet pulled up to the chin, a bedside lamp on.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: WFH like the North Pole
hookbank.line: WFH in winter be like
hookbank.scene: The person sits at a desk with an open laptop wearing a puffer jacket zipped over their outfit, a knit beanie and fingerless gloves, typing stiffly with cold fingers, breath slightly visible, a steaming mug beside the laptop.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: Dog as a heater
hookbank.line: using my dog as a heater. he did not consent.
hookbank.scene: The person sits on the sofa hugging a big fluffy dog tightly against their chest with both arms, cheek pressed into its fur, eyes closed for warmth; the dog looks straight at the camera, unimpressed.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: Duvet as a cape
hookbank.line: leaving my bed like I'm moving house
hookbank.scene: The person walks down the hallway of their home with the entire duvet wrapped around them like a royal cape, dragging behind on the floor, only the face showing, holding a toothbrush in one hand, sleepy and determined.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.

hookbank.name: Hands over the toaster
hookbank.line: desperate times
hookbank.scene: In the kitchen, the person holds both hands flat above the slots of an ordinary toaster that is switched on, a warm orange glow rising from the slots onto their palms, eyes closed in relief, shoulders hunched.
hookbank.note: New hook: no robe in frame, 2 variants (image + Kling), pick the best.
